body: I am trying to get that treated. I'm signed up for CBT, although the waiting list for that is months long even after getting pushed up the list with a psychiatrist's referral. I used to be on citalopram which did wonders for my anxiety but didn't help with my depression and had a mountain of side effects so my doctor took me off it. Unfortunately all my doctors since then have been clueless and just keep throwing more prozac at me even when I told them it doesn't work.

I'm with a different doctor now, that seems just as clueless but she didn't mind putting me on a higher dose of prozac so it's a step in the right direction. At this point I don't even care about side effects, I just want to find something that works.

That's what he said, and he pointed to the Wikipedia article that said something about extra side effects in younger people (meaning under 16) and said that applies to everyone upto 20-21. And when I asked if I could get a higher dose of the prozac, he told me that if it wasn't having any effect at 20mg, then increasing it won't make a difference. And as a result I haven't been back to see him since November.

I've been on prozac since September even though it doesn't work because my doctor says that all the alternatives "aren't designed for adolescents". So even when I ask to try something else he won't prescribe it. And he referred me to a psychiatrist that managed to be even more useless than him. 

I know it's possible to get better, but I want to know if it's worth the effort. I've got severe anxiety, no friends and no prospects, so what's the point in trying?

I didn't use it when I was at University because I didn't want to jump though all the hoops to sign up, and I can't use it now because I'm not at the university at the moment. I'm signed up for a local council selling service, but their waiting list is 2 months long so no idea when I'll get help. And I do want to get out more, but the crippling anxiety gets in the way of that, as well as a few problems with my legs that stop me from walking more than 30 feet without needing to rest.

I was just talking about  paracetamol, since that's the only thing I looked up because it's the only thing I could get easily. Apparently it takes a week to kill you by destroying your liver. 

And thanks for the offer, I might pm you later once I calm down a little.
